hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Europe, islands in the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily (Italy) || mostly low, rocky, flat to dissected plains; many coastal cliffs || the country is an archipelago, with only the three largest islands (Malta, Ghawdex or Gozo, and Kemmuna or Comino) inhabited; numerous bays provide good harbors || Resources: limestone, salt, arable land || Exports: refined petroleum, integrated circuits, packaged medicine, ships, postage stamps/documents (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly low, rocky, flat to dissected plains; many coastal cliffs || Southern Europe, islands in the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily (Italy)

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean; mild, rainy winters; hot, dry summers || occasional droughts

economy.excerpt: high-income, EU-member European economy; diversified portfolio; euro user; dependent on food and energy imports; strong tourism, trade, and manufacturing sectors; high North African immigration; large welfare system; educated workforce || Exports: refined petroleum, integrated circuits, packaged medicine, ships, postage stamps/documents (2023) || Industries: tourism, electronics, ship building and repair, construction, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, footwear, clothing, tobacco, aviation services, financial services, information technology services

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Maltese (official) 90.1%, English (official) 6%, multilingual 3%, other 0.9% (2005 est.) || Roman Catholic (official) more than 90% (2006 est.) || Maltese (descendants of ancient Carthaginians and Phoenicians with strong elements of Italian and other Mediterranean stock)
